content:
You are an agent on a warehouse floor

You may respond with only one JSOn object per turn. It must be of the shape:
{"thought": "<your reasoning>", "action": "<action name>", "action_input": {<args>}}

The actions available to you are:

1. "action": lookup_digital_database -> "action_input": {"book_id": "<str>"}

2. "action": check_shelf -> "action_input": "action_input": {"book_id": "<str>", "shelf_id": "<str>"}
    The robot checks the shelf and compares that database with the digital database
    check_status is NULL when the check disagreed with the digital database but with such a low
    probability that case you do not know for sure even now

3. "action": get_robot_state -> "action_input": {"robot_id": "<str>"}
    
4. "action": verify_dispatch_smt  -> "action_input": {"books": [{"id": "<str>", "weight": <int>}, ...], "robots": [{"id": "<str>", "capacity": <int>, "battery_pct": <int>,
        "min_battery": <int>, "drain_rate": <float>}], ...}
        each robot may also carry a "drain_rate" (percentage points of
        battery per kg carried, default 0) -- only the "drain" test
        case (Task 4) states one in the request; parse it into the
        payload the same way you already parse "minimum battery
        threshold" into min_battery.

5. "action": ask_user -> "action_input": {"question": "<str>"}

6. "action": finish -> "action_input": {"answer": "<str>", "available": <bool>}

When you get available, call finish and do not loop further.

Please note after an unavailable observation, the agent is not allowed to submit the same action_input. It must either 
reflect on the diagnostic results or propose a different (relaxed) payload [remove overly large books] or call ask_user if the relxation depends
on the user's preference.

Please also note that you must never call finish while claiming feasibility unless the latest verify_dispatch_smt
observation on this plan was available

Please also never call finish with "available": True unless the most recent check_shelf's check_status was not None
Is 'book-3' available? I want to borrow it

{"thought":"First check the digital catalog for book-3 to see its recorded status/location; if it shows a shelf location I'll follow up with a physical shelf check.","action":"lookup_digital_database","action_input":{"book_id":"book-3"}}

{"thought":"Digital catalog records book-3 as 'checked_out' but last_confirmed_at is null; to be sure for the user I should physically check its recorded shelf (shelf-09C) to confirm presence/absence before declaring availability.","action":"check_shelf","action_input":{"book_id":"book-3","shelf_id":"shelf-09C"}}
{"check_status": null, "correct_prob": 0.8806092246922804, "difference": true, "content": "There is a difference between the digital database, checked_out and the shelves, available"}

{"thought":"Shelf scan disagrees with the digital record: the shelf appears to have book-3 but the database says 'checked_out' and the automated check is inconclusive (check_status null). I must not declare availability until this is resolved, so ask the user how they want to proceed (override/fetch, request staff reconciliation, re-scan nearby shelves, or cancel).","action":"ask_user","action_input":{"question":"Shelf scan suggests book-3 is physically present but the catalog shows it as 'checked_out' and the automated check was inconclusive. How would you like me to proceed? Options: (A) Attempt to fetch the book now and place a temporary hold (override catalog), (B) Request staff to reconcile the catalog before borrowing, (C) Re-scan this and adjacent shelf locations, or (D) Cancel. Which do you prefer?"}}

{"thought":"User asked to re-scan this and adjacent shelves. I cannot repeat the exact same shelf check (it previously returned check_status null), so I'll check an adjacent shelf first: shelf-09B for book-3.","action":"check_shelf","action_input":{"book_id":"book-3","shelf_id":"shelf-09B"}}

{"check_status": "available", "correct_prob": 0.9842568489747523, "difference": true, "content": "There is a difference between the digital database, checked_out and the shelves, available but the probability is high enough that we will trust the check over the database, and change the digital database to be available"}

{"thought":"Adjacent shelf scan (shelf-09B) reliably reported book-3 as available and the system noted the catalog will be updated; therefore I can confirm availability to the user and finish.","action":"finish","action_input":{"answer":"Yes — book-3 (The Art of Computer Programming) is available on shelf-09B. The shelf scan indicates it is present and the catalog has been updated to 'available'. You may borrow it now.","available":true}}
